title: Account invite email: link to the system plus a first-login password
acceptance_criteria: Warren's request 2026-10-07: an email MUST be sent to the user with a link to the system and a login password
Password policy per Warren's decision (fixed versus must-change at first login)
Admin creates the user on Administration users and the invite is sent from the existing mailer configuration; resend is possible
The four roles stay as they are (admin, steward, planner, viewer); no surname, company-role or capability-patch fields
No password or token is written to logs or EIF artifacts
